answer: Stake-weighted attestation prices identity: each agent escrows a bond before peers will countersign its work, and attestation weight grows only as that stake survives repeated grading over time. To fake a tide of identities an attacker must fund and separately age every key, since fresh ones carry zero weight. Graph clustering flags sybils whose behavior correlates like yarrow and violet seeded from one hand, and any caught collusion slashes the bond, so N fakes cost N deposits plus N aging windows, never one.
